Messages.Author: Jenifer Wierum
Messages.Body:
Can Rumors of Gehenna be called for just one methusala?

Card text says "...name a set of methusalas..." but according to ye olde
math book, "1" is a set (albeit kinda tiny).

Situation came up last session with only two players left (Misdirection
took me out... again!) and one wanted to call RoG for himself. A heated
debate followed; we ordered some pizza and started another game. The
issue was never settled.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


"A set of" means "one or more" in VTES.
So you can name just one Methuselah with Rumors.

--
